series: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry Predictions; IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda Predictions

futurescapes.name: Worldwide IT Industry
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry 2022 Predictions

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda 2022 Predictions

entries.quote: By 2024, Digital-First Enterprises Will Enable Empathetic Customer Experiences and Resilient Operating Models by Shifting 70% of All Tech and Services Spending to as-a-Service and Outcomes-Centric Models
entries.subject: As-a-service spending shift
entries.metric: share of tech and services spending shifted to as-a-service and outcomes-centric models

entries.quote: By 2023, 40% of G2000 Will Reset Cloud Selection Processes to Focus on Business Outcomes Rather than IT Requirements, Valuing Access to Providers' Portfolios from Device to Edge and from Data to Ecosystem
entries.subject: Cloud provider selection
entries.metric: share of G2000 resetting cloud selection processes to business outcomes

entries.quote: By 2023, 80% of Enterprises Will Use AI-Assisted, Cloud-Linked Governance Services to Manage, Optimize, and Secure Dispersed Resources/Data, But 70% Will Not Achieve Full Value Due to IT Skills Mismatches
entries.subject: AI-assisted cloud governance
entries.metric: share of enterprises using AI-assisted, cloud-linked governance services
entries.note: Also: 70% will not achieve full value due to skills mismatches.

entries.quote: By 2022, 40% of Large Enterprises' IT Budgets Will Be Redistributed Due to Adoption of Integrated as-a-Service Bundles in Areas of Security, Cloud Platforms, Virtual Workspace, and Connectivity
entries.subject: As-a-service bundles
entries.metric: share of large enterprises' IT budgets redistributed by integrated aaS bundles

entries.quote: By 2026, Industry Leaders Facing Systemic or Mandated Transitions in the Coming Decade Triple IT Spend for New Environments But Struggle to Achieve the Needed 6x Gains in IT Operational Efficiency
entries.subject: IT spend for mandated transitions
entries.metric: multiple of IT spend by industry leaders facing mandated transitions
entries.note: Also: need 6x gains in IT operational efficiency.

entries.quote: By 2024, 70% of G2000 Will Gain Twice as Much, in Terms of Meaningful Returns, on Tech Investments That Augment Employee/Customer Activities Compared with Ones That Automate Individual Processes
entries.subject: Augmentation vs automation returns
entries.metric: returns on augmenting investments relative to automating ones, for 70% of G2000

entries.quote: By 2025, Regional Divergences in Data Privacy, Security, and Placement/Use/Disclosure Mandates Will Force 80% of Enterprises to Restructure Their Data Governance Processes Built on an Autonomic Foundation
entries.subject: Data governance restructuring
entries.metric: share of enterprises restructuring data governance

entries.quote: By 2023, 50% of G2000 Will Shift Half of Their New Technology Hardware/Connectivity Spending to Modernize and Reconceptualize In-Person Experiences for Customers and Employees in Their Own Locations
entries.subject: In-person experience modernization
entries.metric: share of G2000 shifting half of new hardware/connectivity spend to in-person experiences

entries.quote: By 2025, 60% of G2000 Will Have Digital Sustainability Teams, Tasked with Assessing, Certifying, and Coordinating Use of Business and IT Sustainability Data and Analytic Platforms Offered by ICT Providers
entries.subject: Digital sustainability teams
entries.metric: share of G2000 with digital sustainability teams

entries.quote: By 2025, Public Enterprises' Valuations Will Be Based as Much on Confidence in Data Controls for Proper/Effective Use of Data as in Financial Controls, Focusing Increased Spend on Data-Centric Solutions
entries.subject: Data controls and valuation

entries.quote: Through 2026, 65% of CIOs Will Sustain a Cycle of Tech-Based Empowerment, Agility, and Resilience Through Collaborative Governance, New Service Delivery Models, and a Business Outcomes Orientation
entries.subject: Tech-based empowerment cycle
entries.metric: share of CIOs sustaining tech-based empowerment, agility and resilience

entries.quote: By 2023, 60% of CIOs Will Be Primarily Measured for Their Ability to Cocreate New Business Models and Outcomes Through Extensive Enterprise and Ecosystemwide Collaboration
entries.subject: CIOs measured on business model cocreation
entries.metric: share of CIOs measured on cocreating business models

entries.quote: By 2025, 75% of CIOs and CFOs Will Be Forced to Accelerate or Enact Formal Technical Debt Management Practices Due to Project Delays or Failures Caused by Unresolved Technical Debt
entries.subject: Technical debt management
entries.metric: share of CIOs and CFOs enacting formal technical debt management

entries.quote: Given the Rising Imperative for Hybrid and Smart Workplaces, by 2024, 60% of CIOs Will Reimagine User Support and Create COE-Based Teams to Guide the Necessary Investments in Technology and Process
entries.subject: Hybrid workplace user support
entries.metric: share of CIOs reimagining user support with COE-based teams

entries.quote: By 2026, 85% of Organizations Whose Data Practices Inhibit Their Business and Operating Strategies Will Empower CIOs to Lead Cross-Enterprise Investments in Data Governance, Quality, and Compliance
entries.subject: CIO-led data governance
entries.metric: share of organizations with inhibiting data practices empowering CIOs to lead data governance investments

entries.quote: By 2024, 40% of CIOs Will Fail to Effectively Evolve IT's Capability to Deliver Modern Digital Infrastructures, Provide Ecosystem Tech Governance, and Support Architecture-Driven Business Outcomes
entries.subject: Modern digital infrastructure capability
entries.metric: share of CIOs failing to evolve IT's capability

entries.quote: Driven by Investor Pressure to Minimize SG&A Expenses, by 2024, 40% of Organizations Will Shift at Least 25% of IT Spending to Direct Cost Aligned with Specific LOB Products/Services
entries.subject: IT spending as direct LOB cost
entries.metric: share of organizations shifting at least 25% of IT spending to direct LOB cost

entries.quote: Despite the Cost and Friction, 60% of CIOs Will Embrace Ecosystemwide Multifactor Authentication for Its Efficacy as an Essential Minimum to Counter Rising Cybersecurity Threats by 2022
entries.subject: Multifactor authentication
entries.metric: share of CIOs embracing ecosystemwide MFA

entries.quote: By 2025, 60% of CIOs Will Collaborate to Harness Industry Ecosystem Capabilities as a Critical Source of Innovation, Data Sharing, Differentiation, and Cybersecurity Risk Management
entries.subject: Industry ecosystem innovation
entries.metric: share of CIOs harnessing industry ecosystem capabilities

entries.quote: By 2023, Businesses Will Require 55% of G2000 CIOs to Implement Sustainable IT, Embedding Environmental, Social, and Governance Practices into the Technology Life Cycle from Acquisition to Disposal
entries.subject: Sustainable IT
entries.metric: share of G2000 CIOs required to implement sustainable IT
